blind.description: A low, rustic wooden crate or bin filled with faceted lumps of black coal. The bin features slanted side planks that slope down toward the open front, four thick corner posts reinforced with iron bracket bands and rivets, and a wooden D-handled metal coal shovel thrust into the coal heap. Stylized, clean, hand-painted video game art style with continuous solid geometry.
blind.from_above: A square top-down profile showing the square wooden perimeter frame, four corner post tops, a dense bed of rounded dark coal lumps filling the interior, and the horizontal cross-grip of the shovel handle protruding near the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: The crate reaches roughly knee-height (approx. 1.5 ft tall, with the shovel handle reaching around 2.3 ft), and measures about 2.5 ft wide by 2.5 ft deep.
